REGULAR MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL (CC) OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AND SITTING AS THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY (SA) TO THE COMMUNITY REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE
REGULAR MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL (CC) OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AND SITTING AS THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY (SA) TO THE COMMUNITY REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
TUESDAY, OCTOBER 01, 2019
07:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 1469
www.cityofpalmdaleca.gov
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
SPEAKER FORMS: &nbspFor record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF OUR TROOPS.
3. ROLL CALL: MAYOR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM BISHOP, COUNCILMEMBERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND LOA
4. PRESENTATION:
4.1 Palmdale Animal Care Center representative will present a cute critter that is available for adoption from our local Animal Care Center.
4.2 Presentation by Mayor and Council of a Commendation in memory of Aida O’Connor for her contributions to our community.
4.3 Presentation by Mayor and Council of a Commendation to Tom Hilzendeger with Vets4 Veterans for his contributions to the veterans of our community.
4.4 Presentation by Mayor and Council of a Proclamation proclaiming the week of October 20th – 26th, 2019 as Friends of Libraries Week in the City of Palmdale.
4.5 Presentation by Mayor and Council of a Proclamation proclaiming the week of October 7th – 11th, 2019 as Code Enforcement Officer Appreciation Week in the City of Palmdale.
4.6 Presentation by Mayor and Council of Certificates of Recognition to coordinators, managers, and coaches for their contributions to the City of Palmdale's Novice Swim Team's 1st place finish at the LA84 Foundation Swim Festival:
Coordinators:
Jacki Nuss
Kim Betancourt

5. WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S) and/or ORDINANCE(S):
Staff Recommendation: Move to waive full reading of the Resolution(s) and/or Ordinances(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority to waive.)
6. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON CONSENT CALENDAR AND NON-AGENDA ITEMS:
Staff Recommendation: Approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under this Consent Calendar.
7. CONSENT CALENDAR:
7.1 CC - Accept the monthly report on investment balances as reported on the City of Palmdale's books as of August 31, 2019. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Holmes)
Staff Recommendation: Accept the monthly report on investment balances as reported on the City of Palmdale's books as of August 31, 2019.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.1
7.2 SA - Accept the monthly report on investment balances as reported on the Successor Agency to the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Palmdale's books as of August 31, 2019. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Holmes)
Staff Recommendation: Accept the monthly report on investment balances as reported on the Successor Agency to the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Palmdale's books as of August 31, 2019.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.2
7.3 CC - Award Request for Proposal (RFP) 18-004-3500 Professional Pump Services for Public Works Maintenance and approve Agreement for as-needed professional pump services to PumpMan, LLC, in an amount not to exceed $850,000 for a 3-Year term allocating in Year 1 $284,000 in FY 2019-20, $283,000 in FY 2020-21, and $283,000 in FY 2021-22, budgeted in multiple accounts, Agreement No. A-6770. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Holmes)
Staff Recommendation: Award Request for Proposal (RFP) 18-004-3500 Professional Pump Services for Public Works Maintenance and approve Agreement for as-needed professional pump services to PumpMan, LLC.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.3
7.4 CC - Award and approve Purchase Order No. 20200285 for ninety (90) Dell OptiPlex 5070 SFF desktop computers, ninety (90) Dell 27" monitors and ninety (90) sound bars for an amount not to exceed $116,059.11, budgeted in account 10116001-774400. (Staff Reference: Director of Administrative Services Ambrose)
Staff Recommendation: Award and approve Purchase Order No. 20200285 for ninety (90) Dell OptiPlex 5070 SFF desktop computers, ninety (90) Dell 27" monitors and ninety (90) sound bars for an amount not to exceed $116,059.11, budgeted in account 10116001-774400.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.4
7.5 CC - Adopt Resolution No. CC 2019-076, A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Palmdale authorizing application for, and receipt of, SB 2 Planning Grants Program Funds. (Staff Reference: Director of Economic and Community Development Oyler)
Staff Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. CC 2019-076.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.5

Staff Recommendation: Approve Supplemental Agreement No. 2 for changes to the scope of work provided on Project No. 777, Palmdale Library ADA Upgrade, with MJS Construction, Inc., in the amount of $21,147.72.

S0064240 and S0064201, and authorize the Director of Public Works to file a Notice of Completion, Agreement No. A-6593. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: Acceptance of Completed Capital Project, Project No. 742, Federal Project No. HSIPL-5378 (045), Upgrade Guardrail and End Treatments at 12 locations throughout the City, from C & W Construction Specialties.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.8

Staff Recommendation: Acceptance of Completed Capital Project, Project No. 757, IS Server Room Electrical Upgrade Project, with GA Technical Services, Inc.
